purpose: Static visual exploration for Orbi, the Orbit Aerials website character.

concepts.title: 01 — Orbi / Living Emblem
concepts.descriptor: The Orbit symbol, brought to life.
concepts.direction: The MOST faithful translation of the logo. Make Orbi himself a shallow sculptural 3D version of the six-lobed Orbit emblem. Precisely study the six interwoven elliptical tapered swooshes and retain their distinctive overall outline and negative spaces. Thick satin pearl-white and platinum ribbons, smoothly beveled, arranged in the logo's radial orientation, a compact silhouette with clearly open space in every loop. Very slightly rotate the emblem in 3D so front silhouette stays obviously recognizable. Modestly enlarge the central hexagonal opening to contain a small flush charcoal face, with two warm-white expressive oval eyes and one delicate tiny smile. The face occupies only about one quarter of total width, the flowing actual Orbit loops remain dominant. No big spherical head. One tiny restrained ice-blue rim reflection only. Friendly curious tilt of 8 degrees. Hero floats above a soft shadow. Thumbnail listening pose slightly lifted with wider eyes; thinking pose one eye slightly squinted and gentle tilt. Elegant memorable LOGO creature. This option must feel like the actual logo became alive, not a generic orbiting ball.

concepts.title: 02 — Orbi / Halo Companion
concepts.descriptor: A warm guide with an orbital soul.
concepts.direction: A SOFTER and rounder interpretation. Create a floating dark graphite spherical core with a smooth friendly face, two large soft warm-white eyes, small smile, slight curious lean. The core is approximately 55 percent of total character diameter. SIX sculpted broad pearl-white and satin silver looping ribbons surround this core, echoing the SIX swooshes of the supplied logo in a round 3D cage. The six loop lobes must read individually in silhouette; no fine hair strands and no generic single Saturn ring. Ribbons arc around the sides and behind, leaving a clear open face at front, with alternating slim and broad tapered sections derived from the logo. Soft rounded contours, approachable and very expressive but still premium. Gentle desaturated ice-blue highlights on the metal; no pink or copper. No extra body or limbs. It is one levitating orbital companion. More dimensional volume and larger eyes than a literal emblem. Hero rendered in slight three-quarter view with a subtle contact shadow. Listening raises/opens the ribbons a little and widens the eyes; thinking tilts the orbital cage and narrows one eye. Keep topology consistent in every pose.

concepts.title: 03 — Orbi / Spatial Scout
concepts.descriptor: Curious eyes. A precise point of view.
concepts.direction: A more TECHNICAL and sculptural Orbital intelligence character. A floating compact obsidian rounded-HEXAGON face module references the tiny hexagonal center of the actual Orbit logo. It is not a camera lens or cyclops: give it TWO understated ice-white expressive pill-shaped eyes and a very small warm smile. SIX elegantly engineered thin flat titanium ribbon loops radiate and curl around the central hexagon, directly tracing the same six-lobed interwoven silhouette as the supplied Orbit logo; broad near central attachment, tapered at the sweeping tips. The ribbons are lightweight matte silver on outer surfaces with tiny inset muted ice-blue edges only, not bright neon. Think precision aerospace instrument turned into a friendly guide, not a toy robot, drone or armor. Face width about 35 percent of total width; wider open gaps between the six loops than Halo Companion. Controlled surfaces, subtle machined bevels and minimal seams. Hero is front three-quarter with a confident inquisitive tilt, hovering above a soft shadow. In smaller poses, loop orientation opens slightly to suggest surveying space; thoughtful expression looks off to one side. This is distinctly angular/hexagonal and lean compared with the softer companion. No holographic interface panels, no labels beyond specified text.
